basic_info.description: Charming mid-century home with a front living room bathed in natural light from a picture window featuring a wood-burning fireplace and beautiful hardwood floors. The dining and kitchen area is highlighted with a skylight, multiple windows, refrigerator, Wedgewood stove, and built-in cabinets. Two good sized West-facing rear bedrooms and a full bathroom complete the main level. Stairs led down to a large primary bedroom suite which offers great options for multi-generational living. It has an entrance from the garage and opens to a spacious deck overlooking a nice backyard - perfect for gardening, entertaining & BBQs. A large basement provides plenty of storage space and offers expansion potential for a multi-purpose room. The 1-car garage is spacious enough for additional storage and includes a convenient laundry area with washer/dryer and shelves. Solar system and panels installed in 2019.   Great location near multiple public transit lines to city & downtown, shopping, restaurants, cafes, schools, parks, and natural preserves. Easy access to freeways and airport makes commuting North or South a breeze. This property is ideal for first-time homebuyers and investors. Experience the perfect blend of mid-century charm and modern convenience from this must-see Bayview gem!
